Personalised Equine Care

Hi, I’m Martin.

I provide complete personalised equine care for horses and donkeys across the Western Victoria region and help owners with a natural care plan. With optimal hoof health, regular muscle therapy and a saddle that fits comfortably, your maned friend will soon feel healthier and happier and you’ll both be riding better. I look forward to meeting you and your horse or donkey soon!

The people who trust me with their horse

Martin has been trimming all of my horses’ feet for many years. He is a man of great integrity, always reliable, punctual and honest.  He demonstrates compassion to all horses and humans.  Everyone of my horses’ feet have improved considerably in condition and strength with Martin’s expert trimming and advice.  His dedication to his craft and the safety of the horse and owner during the trimming process is commendable.  With the added bonus of great conversation, he is my first recommendation as a barefoot trimmer.

J. Van Opstal – Ararat

Martin has been trimming my horses for 6 years now. He does a fantastic job (even with my sometimes difficult horse). Both my horses and dogs love him and he’s always on time. Martin would easily be the most reliable farrier I’ve dealt with in over 25 years of owning horses.

S. Morris – Mt Egerton

A farrier that has a diary, books you in advance and turns up!  Martin has a fabulous relationship with the horses and his attention to detail and work overall is to be applauded. The horses’ wellbeing is his priority, couldn’t be happier.

H. Tatchell - Ballan

I have been using Martin Godwin for a very long time. His very reliable and always on time.  Excellent with horses, as he truly understands them. My big babies truly love him. I am a Clydesdale breeder and my horses feet are well cared for.  Martin truly is a genius with horses’ feet.  I highly recommend him. I have never ever been disappointed with Martin.

C. Caps - Beaufort

I’ve been using Martins service for the past 6 years and I have always found him to be reliable, professional and has a fantastic manner with my horses and all their different personalities. Martin is very knowledgeable and keeps up with modern practices which greatly benefits my horses in their disciplines. Highly recommend Martin.

C. Blackley - Ararat

Martin builds a bond with the horses and they interact well with him. The appointments are always met and he is never late. Martin can be trusted to look after your equine friends to the highest standards of hoof care. Certainly recommend!

S. Ryan – Great Western

If you want a farrier who is always on time, kind, patient, trims and balances their hooves to perfection. Plus has knowledge of the anatomy and physiology of the lower limb and teaches you and your equines every visit. Martin Godwin should be your farrier as he has been my farrier for 13+ years for my Clydesdales, mini ponies, mini donkeys and mammoth donkeys.

C. Trotter - Winchelsea

Martin actually really cares about the horses and is passionate about his work. He is very reliable, always here when he says he will, so no waiting around for him! We always have a laugh and some good discussions. But best of all my horses are always sound. Thanks Martin!

L. McLaren - Ballan

Martin, Best Trimmer Ever!  8 years ago, I made the decision to go barefoot and after extensive research on qualified barefoot trimmers, I decided to contact Martin. I have been using Martin ever since and I continue to be impressed with Martin’s professionalism and reliability. My horses’ hoofs have never looked better, Martin continually demonstrates genuine care and pride in his trimming and hoof care of my horses. Martin has excellent horse handing skills and I cannot recommend him highly enough.

M. Cooper - Gordon
